name: How does a contractor handle door frame repairs that sit right next to kitchen tile?

mainEntity.name: How does a contractor handle door frame repairs that sit right next to kitchen tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen entryways, pantry doors, and exterior access doors often border tiled backsplashes, tall baseboards, or tiled floors. Vibrations or careless removal during frame repair can crack adjacent grout or chip tile edges. Working with a finish contractor experienced in both carpentry and tile installation ensures the old jamb and casings are carefully detached without disturbing delicate surrounds, and any necessary transitions between the new wood trim and tile surfaces are neatly re-caulked and sealed.
acceptedAnswer.description: A skilled carpenter scores caulk lines and gently frees the jamb to protect adjacent tile and grout, repairing transitions cleanly without chipping nearby surfaces.
